Detailed features of the pre-heater have been mentioned in Table 3. Table 3: Features of BF Gas Pre-heater Description Parameter Type Indirect-fired heater (NG based) Inlet Temperature 320 oF Outlet Temperature 773 oF Heat Duty 171.4 MMBtu/hr Flue gas quantity 381,428 lb/hr with 15% excess air Heat Release(LHV) 230 MMBtu/hr Component-1 Combustion chamber, Convection section, Stack, Inlet/outlet ducting Component-2 Low NOx NG fired burner, Combustion air system, etc Inlet Temperature 320 oF Attachment-7: Initial Engineering Design and Cost Estimate 5 DE-FE0031937 / 0009 3.2.3 Water Gas Shift (WGS) Reactor The compressed & pre-heated gases are mixed with low-pressure (LP) steam to achieve a steam-to-dry gas ratio of 0.57 and flows from top to bottom through the high-temperature shift reactor (also called HT CO- Shift reactor) developed by Air-Liquide filled with Iron-Chromium oxide catalyst (Vendor: Clariant) that is designed for 4 years of lifetime. There are 4 parallel sets of reactors to cater to the large volume of gas considering a 50% turndown operation design. The CO content at the outlet of the reactor is approx. 3.8 to 4 mol% (dry). Detailed features of WGS reactor are mentioned in Table 4. Table 4: Features of WGS Reactor Description Parameter Reactor Vertical type (4 sets) Length(TL-TL) 15.65 ft Diameter 21.5 ft Design Temp 900 F max Design Pressure 75 psig Volume(TL-TL) 5575 ft3 Internals FeO cat.: 4,061 ft³ +3% spare for loading allowance, Al balls 1": 491 ft³, Al Balls 2": 1,455 ft³ 3.2.4 WGS Boiler and Boiler Feed Water (BFW) Pre-heater The hot gas from the WGS reactor is passed through Kettle-type Reboiler (named WGS boiler) to generate steam and is further cooled by a shell & tube heat exchanger. The heat exchanger pre-heats the boiler feed water and is thus named BFW pre-heater. Detailed features of the WGS boiler and BFW pre-heater are mentioned in Table 5. Table 5: Features of WGS Boiler and BFW Pre-heater Description Parameters of WGS Boiler Parameter of BFW Pre-heater Type Kettle-type reboiler Shell & tube heat exchanger Heat duty 283.6 MMBtu/hr 65.8 MMBtu/hr Tube count 1,485 1,237 Tube length/diameter 35’/2” 20’/2” Inlet & outlet temp (water), oF 293 (liquid) / 293 (vapor) 90 (liquid) / 293 (liquid) Inlet & outlet temp (Process), oF 839 (gas) / 365 (gas) 365 (gas) / 250 (gas) Overall length/width 44’/146” 28’/96’6” Overall height 15’ 10’ 3.2.5 Quench Tower & Process Condensate Pumps The cooled gas from BFW pre-heater is passed through a counter-current packed tower in a quench tower, where contact cooling water is recirculated to cool the flue gas from approximately 250°F to 91°F.
